body: STORY-1728 has a new amendments comment, agreed by the operator: A1 ratchet, A2 GlobalArgs, A3 built_command() plus a guard, A4 split out as ADR-78 (gates slice 4), A5 dropped. Slice 1 development starts in a worktree around 03:30 -07:00, and landing waits for a quiet window you announce (C2).
